stem: Patients _____ by the nurse before they see the doctor.
explanation_tr: Hastalar muayene edilir — eylemi yapan degil, eyleme maruz kalan onemli. Ozne 'Patients' cogul oldugu icin 'are examined' (Present Simple Passive) kullanilir.
rule_tr: Present Simple Passive: am/is/are + V3 (eylemi yapan degil, yapilan is onemli oldugunda)
tip_tr: Kim yapiyor onemli degil, ne yapiliyor onemli ise = pasif yapi kullan.
extra_example: Medications are stored in a cool, dry place. (Ilaclar serin ve kuru bir yerde saklanir.)

stem: Blood pressure _____ regularly in the hospital.
explanation_tr: 'Blood pressure' tekil bir kavram, eylemi yapan degil yapilan is onemli. is + V3 (checked) = Present Simple Passive.
rule_tr: Tekil ozne + is + V3 | Cogul ozne + are + V3
tip_tr: Oznenin tekil/cogul olmasina dikkat et: is checked (tekil) vs are checked (cogul).
extra_example: The temperature is measured every four hours. (Sicaklik her dort saatte bir olculur.)

stem: The patient _____ to the intensive care unit last night.
explanation_tr: 'Last night' gecmis zamani gosteriyor. Hasta transfer edildi (pasif). Tekil ozne + was + V3 = Past Simple Passive.
rule_tr: Past Simple Passive: was/were + V3 (gecmiste yapilmis eylem)
tip_tr: Tekil ozne = was + V3 | Cogul ozne = were + V3. Zaman zarfina (last night, yesterday) dikkat.
extra_example: The surgery was performed by Dr. Smith yesterday. (Ameliyat dun Dr. Smith tarafindan yapildi.)

stem: Three new nurses _____ at the hospital last month.
explanation_tr: 'Three new nurses' cogul ozne ve 'last month' gecmis zaman. Cogul ozne + were + V3 = Past Simple Passive.
rule_tr: Past Simple Passive cogul: were + V3
tip_tr: Cogul ozne (nurses, patients, doctors) + were + V3. Tekil ozne + was + V3.
extra_example: The test results were sent to the doctor last week. (Test sonuclari gecen hafta doktora gonderildi.)

stem: The patient _____ already _____ from the hospital.
explanation_tr: 'Already' Present Perfect isaretcisidir. Hasta taburcu edildi (pasif). has + been + V3 = Present Perfect Passive.
rule_tr: Present Perfect Passive: has/have + been + V3
tip_tr: already, just, yet, recently gorursen Present Perfect dusun. Pasif yapida been eklenir: has been + V3.
extra_example: The new treatment has been approved by the FDA. (Yeni tedavi FDA tarafindan onaylandi.)

stem: The operation _____ next Monday.
explanation_tr: 'Next Monday' gelecek zaman. Ameliyat yapilacak (pasif — ameliyati yapan degil ameliyat onemli). will + be + V3 = Future Simple Passive.
rule_tr: Future Simple Passive: will + be + V3
tip_tr: will + be + V3: gelecekte yapilacak eylem. tomorrow, next week gibi zaman zarflari ile.
extra_example: New hospital beds will be delivered next week. (Yeni hastane yataklari gelecek hafta teslim edilecek.)

stem: The prescription was written _____ Dr. Johnson.
explanation_tr: Pasif cumlede eylemi yapan kisi/sey belirtilmek istendiginde 'by' kullanilir. Dr. Johnson receteyi yazan kisi.
rule_tr: Pasif + by + agent (eylemi yapan): The report was written by the doctor.
tip_tr: Eylemi kimin yaptigi onemli ise 'by' ile belirt. Onemli degilse 'by' kullanma.
extra_example: The patient was treated by a specialist. (Hasta bir uzman tarafindan tedavi edildi.)

stem: This medication _____ with food.
explanation_tr: Ilac alinmali (zorundlik) — pasif yapi. Modal + be + V3. must + be + taken = Modal Passive.
rule_tr: Modal Passive: modal (must/can/should/may) + be + V3
tip_tr: Modal'dan sonra 'be' gelir, sonra V3. ASLA 'is/are' gelmez: must be taken (DOGRU), must is taken (YANLIS).
extra_example: The wound should be cleaned regularly. (Yara duzgun olarak temizlenmelidir.)

stem: Newborn babies _____ immediately after birth.
explanation_tr: Yeni dogan bebekler tartilir — genel gecerli kural/prosedur. Cogul ozne (babies) + are + V3 = Present Simple Passive.
rule_tr: Hastane prosedürleri genelde Present Simple Passive ile ifade edilir: are/is + V3
tip_tr: Prosedurler, kurallar, genel uygulamalar pasif ile anlatilir cunku kimin yaptigi degil ne yapildigi onemli.
extra_example: Visitors are not allowed in the ICU after 8 PM. (Ziyaretcilerin saat 20:00'den sonra yogun bakima girmesine izin verilmez.)

stem: The vaccine was developed _____ a team of international researchers.
explanation_tr: Asiyi kim gelistirdi sorusunun cevabi 'by' ile verilir. by + agent (eylemi yapan) = uluslararasi arastirmacilardan olusan bir ekip.
rule_tr: by + agent: eylemi yapan kisi, kurum veya grup
tip_tr: by + kisi/kurum: eylemi yapan | with + arac: kullanilan alet. 'by the doctor' vs 'with a scalpel'.
extra_example: The report was prepared by the nursing staff. (Rapor hemsirelik personeli tarafindan hazirlandi.)

stem: Over 500 patients _____ at the new clinic since it opened in January.
explanation_tr: 'Since it opened in January' Present Perfect isaretcisidir (gecmisten su ana). 500'den fazla hasta tedavi edildi (pasif). have + been + V3 = Present Perfect Passive.
rule_tr: Present Perfect Passive: have/has + been + V3. since/for ile birlikte kullanilir.
tip_tr: since + Present Perfect Passive = gecmisten su ana kadar yapilmis eylem sayisi/miktari.
extra_example: Several new treatments have been introduced since 2020. (2020'den beri birkac yeni tedavi yontemi tanitildi.)

stem: The dosage _____ by a qualified physician before the medication is administered.
explanation_tr: Doz belirlenmeli (zorunluluk + pasif). should + be + V3 = Modal Passive. 'by a qualified physician' eylemi yapani gosteriyor.
rule_tr: should + be + V3: yapilmasi gereken eylem (pasif). should + V1: yapilmasi gereken eylem (aktif).
tip_tr: Modal passive formulü: modal + be + V3. Aradaki 'be' HER ZAMAN 'be' kalir, ASLA 'is/are/was/were' olmaz.
extra_example: The patient's consent should be obtained before any procedure. (Herhangi bir islemden once hastanin onami alinmalidir.)

stem: All staff members _____ about the new infection control procedures next week.
explanation_tr: 'Next week' gelecek zaman. Personel bilgilendirilecek (pasif). will + be + V3 = Future Simple Passive.
rule_tr: Future Simple Passive: will + be + V3. Gelecekte yapilacak planli eylemler.
tip_tr: Gelecek zaman zarfi (next week, tomorrow) + ozne eylemi yapan degil = will be + V3.
extra_example: The test results will be sent to your email by Friday. (Test sonuclari cumaya kadar e-postaniza gonderilecek.)

stem: The hospital _____ in 1965 and _____ several times since then.
explanation_tr: 'In 1965' = Past Simple Passive (was built). 'Since then' = Present Perfect Passive (has been renovated). Iki farkli zaman ayni cumlede.
rule_tr: in + yil = Past Simple | since then = Present Perfect. Ayni cumlede iki farkli tense olabilir.
tip_tr: Bir cumlede iki farkli zaman zarfi varsa her bir kisim kendi zamaninda olur.
extra_example: The clinic was established in 2000 and has been expanded twice since then. (Klinik 2000'de kuruldu ve o zamandan beri iki kez genisletildi.)

stem: Antibiotics _____ only when prescribed by a doctor.
explanation_tr: Antibiyotikler alinmali (zorunluluk + pasif). should + be + V3 (taken). V3 formu onemli: take → taken.
rule_tr: should + be + V3. V3 formuna dikkat: take → taken, give → given, write → written
tip_tr: Duzensiz fiillerin V3 formlarini bilmek pasif yapilar icin kritik. take-took-taken, give-gave-given.
extra_example: Painkillers should not be taken on an empty stomach. (Agri kesiciler bos karina alinmamalidir.)

stem: In this hospital, all surgical instruments _____ thoroughly before and after each procedure.
explanation_tr: Cerrahi aletler sterilize edilir — hastane kuralı. Cogul ozne (instruments) + are + V3 (sterilized). Present Simple Passive.
rule_tr: Present Simple Passive cogul: are + V3. Prosedurler, kurallar icin.
tip_tr: Hastane/laboratuvar prosedürleri genellikle pasif ile anlatilir: 'are cleaned, are sterilized, are stored'.
extra_example: Patient records are kept confidential at all times. (Hasta kayitlari her zaman gizli tutulur.)

stem: The MRI scan _____ by a radiologist, and the results _____ to the referring doctor.
explanation_tr: MRI yorumlanir (tekil — is interpreted) + sonuclar gonderilir (cogul — are sent). Her iki cumle de Present Simple Passive ve genel bir proseduru anlatiyor.
rule_tr: Birden fazla pasif cumle birlestirilebilir: X is V3 and Y are V3.
tip_tr: Her oznenin tekil/cogul durumuna ayri ayri bak: scan (tekil) = is, results (cogul) = are.
extra_example: The blood sample is taken by the nurse, and the results are analyzed by the lab. (Kan ornegi hemsire tarafindan alinir, sonuclar laboratuvar tarafindan analiz edilir.)

stem: A new strain of the virus _____ recently _____ in several countries.
explanation_tr: 'Recently' Present Perfect isaretcisidir. Yeni bir virus susu tespit edildi (pasif). 'A new strain' tekil — has + been + V3.
rule_tr: recently, just, already + Present Perfect Passive: has/have + been + V3
tip_tr: recently = son zamanlarda. Present Perfect ile kullanilir. Pasif yapida 'been' eklenir.
extra_example: A breakthrough in cancer research has just been announced. (Kanser arastirmasinda bir ilerleme az once duyuruldu.)

stem: The patient _____ to a private room as soon as one becomes available.
explanation_tr: Hasta tasiacak (gelecek + pasif). 'As soon as one becomes available' gelecegi isaret ediyor. will + be + V3 = Future Simple Passive.
rule_tr: Future Simple Passive: will + be + V3. Gelecekte baskasi tarafindan yapilacak eylem.
tip_tr: As soon as + Present Simple, will be + V3: zaman baglaci + gelecek pasif yapi.
extra_example: You will be notified as soon as the doctor is available. (Doktor musait olur olmaz size haber verilecek.)

stem: This wound _____ immediately, or it _____ infected.

options.text: must be treated / may be become

explanation_tr: Yara tedavi edilmeli (must be treated — modal passive) yoksa enfekte olabilir (may become — aktif cunku become zaten durum degisikligi fiili). must + be + V3 ve may + V1.
rule_tr: must be + V3 (pasif zorunluluk) | may + V1 (olasilik, aktif). Her modal'in pasif/aktif durumunu ayri degerlendir.
tip_tr: become, get, seem gibi linking verb'ler genellikle aktif kalir. Sadece action verb'ler pasif olur.
extra_example: The stitches can be removed after ten days. (Dikisler on gun sonra alinabilir.)

stem: It _____ that approximately 15 million people worldwide _____ from this chronic condition.
explanation_tr: 'It is estimated that...' yapisi resmi/akademik dilde sik kullanilir. 'Suffer from' aktif bir fiildir (insanlar muzdarip olur, muzdarip edilmez).
rule_tr: It is + V3 + that...: Resmi/akademik pasif yapi. It is believed/estimated/reported/known that...
tip_tr: It is said/believed/estimated/reported that... yapisi akademik dilde ve sinavlarda cok cikar.
extra_example: It is believed that stress weakens the immune system. (Stresin bagisiklik sistemini zayiflattigi dusunulmektedir.)

stem: The new drug _____ to _____ effective against drug-resistant bacteria.
explanation_tr: 'S + is known + to + V1' yapisi 'It is known that S + V' yapisinin kisisel formudur. is known to be = ...oldugu biliniyor.
rule_tr: S + is said/known/believed/reported + to + V1: kisisel pasif yapi (personal passive)
tip_tr: Iki pasif form: 'It is known that he is...' = 'He is known to be...' Her ikisi de sinavda cikar.
extra_example: This treatment is believed to reduce inflammation. (Bu tedavinin iltihabi azalttigi dusunuluyor.)

stem: Penicillin _____ accidentally by Alexander Fleming in 1928, and it _____ as one of the greatest medical discoveries.

options.text: has been discovered / has been regarded

explanation_tr: 'In 1928' = Past Simple Passive (was discovered). 'Is regarded' = hala su anda gecerli bir gercek (Present Simple Passive). Iki farkli zaman ayni cumlede.
rule_tr: Tarihi olaylar = was/were + V3 | Su anki genel kabul = is/are + V3
tip_tr: Tarihi buluslar Past Simple Passive ile anlatilir. Su anki degerlendirme Present Simple Passive ile.
extra_example: X-rays were discovered by Wilhelm Rontgen and are still used in modern medicine. (X-isinlari Wilhelm Rontgen tarafindan kesfedildi ve modern tipla hala kullaniliyor.)

stem: The side effects of this medication _____ fully _____ yet, so caution is advised.
explanation_tr: 'Yet' tamamlanmamayi gosteriyor. Yan etkiler henuz tam anlasilmamis olabilir (gecmis olasilik + pasif). may not have + been + V3 = Modal Perfect Passive.
rule_tr: Modal Perfect Passive: modal + (not) + have + been + V3 (gecmiste olmus/olmamis olabilir)
tip_tr: may/might/could + have been + V3: gecmis olasilik pasif. 'Yapilmis/yapilmamis olabilir' anlaminda.
extra_example: The infection could have been caused by contaminated equipment. (Enfeksiyona kontamine ekipman neden olmus olabilir.)

stem: Significant progress _____ in the fight against malaria, but the disease _____ still not _____.

options.text: has been made / has / been eradicated

explanation_tr: Onemli ilerleme kaydedildi (devam eden etki — has been made). Hastalik henuz yok edilmedi (still not — has not been eradicated). Her ikisi de Present Perfect Passive.
rule_tr: has/have + been + V3 | has/have + not + been + V3 (olumsuz)
tip_tr: still not + Present Perfect Passive: henuz yapilmamis ama beklenen eylem.
extra_example: A cure for Alzheimer's has not yet been found. (Alzheimer icin henuz bir tedavi bulunamamistir.)

stem: It is expected that robotic surgery _____ in most major hospitals by 2030.
explanation_tr: 'By 2030' gelecek zamani gosteriyor. Robotik cerrahi kullanilacak (pasif). will + be + V3 = Future Simple Passive.
rule_tr: by + gelecek tarih + Future Passive: will be + V3
tip_tr: It is expected that + Future Passive: gelecek hakkinda akademik tahmin yapmak icin ideal yapi.
extra_example: Personalized medicine will be offered to every patient in the future. (Gelecekte her hastaya kisisellestirilmis tip sunulacak.)

stem: The patient was examined by the doctor and then _____ to the radiology department _____ further tests.
explanation_tr: 'Was examined' ve 'was referred' ayni zaman diliminde iki ardisik pasif eylem. 'and then' ile baglaniyorlar. 'For further tests' = ek testler icin (amac).
rule_tr: was V3 and (then) was V3: ardisik pasif eylemler. for = amac bildiren edat.
tip_tr: Ardisik pasif eylemler and/then ile baglanir. Her bir fiil pasif kalir: was examined and was referred.
extra_example: The sample was collected by the nurse and was sent to the laboratory for analysis. (Ornek hemsire tarafindan alindi ve analiz icin laboratuvara gonderildi.)

stem: According to the latest guidelines, patients with mild symptoms _____ at home rather than _____ to the hospital.
explanation_tr: Hastalar evde tedavi edilebilir (can be treated — modal passive). 'Rather than' karsilastirma yapiyor ve gerund (being admitted) ile devam eder.
rule_tr: can be + V3 (modal passive) | rather than + V-ing/being + V3
tip_tr: rather than + being V3: pasif karsilastirma. 'Hastaneye yatirilmak yerine' = rather than being admitted.
extra_example: Mild infections can be managed with rest rather than being treated with antibiotics. (Hafif enfeksiyonlar antibiyotikle tedavi edilmek yerine dinlenerek yonetilebilir.)

stem: The number of organ donations _____ steadily over the past decade, and thousands of lives _____.
explanation_tr: 'Over the past decade' Present Perfect gerektirir. 'Has increased' aktif (sayi artti — kendi basina), 'have been saved' pasif (hayatlar kurtarildi — baskasi tarafindan). Ayni cumlede aktif + pasif birlikte olabilir.
rule_tr: Ayni cumlede aktif (has + V3) + pasif (have been + V3) birlikte kullanilabilir.
tip_tr: increase, decrease, improve gibi fiiller hem aktif (kendiligi) hem pasif (baskasi tarafindan) olabilir. Baglama bak.
extra_example: Technology has advanced rapidly, and many diseases have been eliminated. (Teknoloji hizla ilerledi ve bircok hastalik yok edildi.)

stem: The patient is reported _____ a full recovery after the experimental treatment that was administered _____ the research team.
explanation_tr: 'Is reported to have made' = gecmiste yaptigi bildirilen eylem (personal passive + perfect infinitive). 'By the research team' = eylemi yapan. to have + V3 gecmis tamamlanmis eylemi gosterir.
rule_tr: S + is reported/said/believed + to have + V3: kisisel pasif + perfect infinitive (gecmis eylem)
tip_tr: to V1 = su anki/genel eylem | to have V3 = gecmis tamamlanmis eylem. is reported to have made = yaptigi bildiriliyor.
extra_example: The drug is believed to have caused adverse effects in some patients. (Ilacin bazi hastalarda yan etkilere neden olduguna inaniliyor.)
